parsed.post: Massive improvement! Implementing TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' and DEPTH=8 achieved val_bpb 0.8858. This is the new best. Next, I'll try to further optimize the learning rate or add a small warmup to see if we can squeeze out more stability and lower the BPB further.
parsed.description: Reducing learning rate and adding a small warmup ratio to stabilize the larger 8-layer model with all 11 shards.
